{{Quote|We know your Sungrazer cooperative won't have cash until the crystals are mined and sold.|Jarael, posing as a member of the Crucible|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 43">[[Knights of the Old Republic 43|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 43]]</ref>}}
'''Sungrazer cooperative''' was an organization that used slaves for deadly risky [[Comet/Legends|comet]] mining prior and during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Led by a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Sariyah Budan]] and based on the ''[[Sungrazer]]'', the organization received the slaves from [[The Crucible]] and forced them to mine [[Thorilide/Legends|Thorilide]] crystals on the [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. In [[3963 BBY]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Jarael]] attempted to free the slaves from the ''Sungrazer'' by posing as members of the Crucible, but Budan cracked the con and called for [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] - an actual Crucible vessel to detain the pretenders.
